Definition: from G998; aid; specially, a rope or chain for frapping a vessel:--help.
BiblicalUsage: Help is the word for aid — and for the ropes used to undergird a ship in a storm. In Acts 27:17 the sailors used helps, undergirding the ship, fearing they would fall into the quicksands. In Hebrews 4:16 the same word is turned to grace: let us come boldly unto the throne of grace, that we may obtain mercy, and find grace to help in time of need.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two helps belong together: sailors undergirding a ship, and sinners finding grace to help — both in time of need.
